companies.text: A trader alleges that a new risk restriction was applied to earlier trades and a reward denied. Purchase-time terms, individual notices and trade dates have not been reconciled; retroactive enforcement is not established.
companies.heading: Reward denial allegedly based on retroactive risk limits

companies.text: A 22 September 2026 report includes the firm acknowledging some mandatory PRIME migrations. Treatment of accrued profits is disputed. The firm rejects the payout-deferral characterization; this does not establish retrospective invalidation of past trades.
companies.heading: Mandatory PRIME migration and accrued profits disputed
companies.evidence_label: Company response available; delivery of notice unverified

companies.text: Section 6.5 does not guarantee grandfathering and permits retroactive changes to features, pricing and payout structures. Section 13 addresses existing users and notification. These are contractual powers; their exercise in a specific payout denial has not been established.
companies.heading: Terms expressly permit retroactive changes
companies.evidence_label: Confirmed in terms; not an enforcement finding

companies.text: A trader alleges that a VPS ban was applied to an older account. The official FAQ expressly exempts purchases before 12 August 2026 from the new VPS restriction. Purchase proof, denial notice and tools used were not independently verified; application remains disputed.
companies.heading: Payout denial allegedly applies a new VPS rule to an old account

companies.text: A May 2025 first-person post alleges a profit reduction under a rule introduced after joining, followed by non-payment and account closure. Earlier terms, notices and attachments were not independently verified, and the firm’s explanation has not been reconciled.
companies.heading: Profit reduction and non-payment allegedly follow a new rule

companies.text: A December 2025 reviewer alleges that news-trading rules changed after purchase; the firm acknowledges a rule update. It says advance email and a warning after a breach were provided. Individual emails were not verified, so lack of notice is not established.
companies.heading: Post-purchase news-rule change and account sanction disputed
companies.evidence_label: Company response available; delivery of notice unverified
